issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: the exercise text and template refer to an interface named Rideable with method messageOnRide(), but the solution repository defines and uses an interface named Mountable (Mountable.java) and Pig/Seal implement Mountable. Additionally, Rideable.java in the solution repository is empty. This mismatch between Rideable vs. Mountable across artifacts will confuse students about which interface to implement and can cause compilation or test integration failures when implementations or tests expect a single consistent interface name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Two viable options: (A) Rename Mountable.java to Rideable.java (or make Mountable a proper alias of Rideable) and update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable; remove or replace the empty Rideable.java in the solution repository. Ensure the interface declares String messageOnRide(). Update any references in template and problem statement if needed. Or (B) update the problem statement and template to refer to Mountable instead of Rideable, and ensure the interface file and class implementations consistently use Mountable with the method messageOnRide().

issues.description: Concept: the interface representing animals that can be ridden (method messageOnRide()). Problem statement and template name this interface 'Rideable' (problem_statement.md declares Rideable and instructs to define Rideable; template Main.java uses Rideable in examples). The solution repository instead provides an interface named 'Mountable' (solution/src/.../Mountable.java) and has Pig.java and Seal.java implement 'Mountable'. The file Rideable.java in the solution is effectively empty. This cross-artifact identifier mismatch (Rideable vs Mountable) means students cannot straightforwardly map the exercise requirement ('Rideable') to the provided solution code ('Mountable'), and may implement or reference the wrong interface name, causing confusion or compilation/test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single identifier for the rideable interface across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's Mountable interface to Rideable (file Mountable.java -> Rideable.java), update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable, and remove or populate the existing empty Rideable.java so the template, problem text, and solution consistently reference Rideable.messageOnRide(). Alternatively, if 'Mountable' is preferred, update the problem statement and template to use 'Mountable' and ensure Rideable.java is removed or replaced so all artifacts match.
